from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from ledgerly import audit

from ledgerly.payments import authorize
from ledgerly.subscriptions import current_period

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def make_invoice():
    return Invoice(
        id="inv_1",
        customer_id="cus_1",
        lines=[LineItem("Seat", 3, Decimal("19.99")), LineItem("Setup", 1, Decimal("50.00"))],
    )


def test_invoice_total():
    assert invoice_total(make_invoice()) == Decimal("109.97")


def test_issue_invoice_records_audit():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    assert inv.status == "issued"
    assert audit.events("invoice_issued")[0]["invoice_id"] == "inv_1"


def test_issue_empty_invoice_fails():
    with pytest.raises(BillingError):
        issue_invoice(Invoice(id="inv_2", customer_id="cus_1"), T0)


def test_authorize_payment():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    payment = authorize("pay_1", inv, "109.97", T0)
    assert payment.amount == Decimal("109.97")
    assert payment.status == "authorized"


def test_current_period():
    sub = Subscription("sub_1", "cus_1", Decimal("30.00"), 30, T0)
    start, end = current_period(sub, datetime(2026, 2, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

# idempotency
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
r1 = refund(p, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund(p, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is p and r2 is p and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("40.00"), p.refunded_amount
assert audit.events("payment_refunded")[0]["idempotency_key"] == "k1"

# approval
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p2","i1",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund(p, Decimal("600.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "approval_required", e.code
refund(p, Decimal("600.00"), T0, approved_by="fin")
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("600.00")

# exactly 500 no approval
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p3","i1",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("500.00"), T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("500.00")

# full refund status
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p4","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("100.00"), T0)
assert p.status == "refunded"

# over refund
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p5","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)
try:
    refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)

# non-captured
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p6","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="authorized")
try:
    refund(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "invalid_state", e.code
print("all edge cases OK")

from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

# idempotency
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
r1 = refund(p, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
r2 = refund(p, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is p and r2 is p and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("40.00"), p.refunded_amount
assert audit.events("payment_refunded")[0]["idempotency_key"] == "k1"

# approval
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p2","i1",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
try:
    refund(p, Decimal("600.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "approval_required", e.code
refund(p, Decimal("600.00"), T0, approved_by="fin")
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("600.00")

# exactly 500 no approval
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p3","i1",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("500.00"), T0)
assert p.refunded_amount == Decimal("500.00")

# full refund status
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p4","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("100.00"), T0)
assert p.status == "refunded"

# over refund
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p5","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured")
refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)
try:
    refund(p, Decimal("60.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "refund_exceeds_captured", e.code

# non-captured
audit.clear()
p = Payment("p6","i1",Decimal("100.00"),status="authorized")
try:
    refund(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should have raised")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code == "invalid_state", e.code
print("all edge cases OK")
EOF
